text: Parts match changed PATHS only, so a part cannot express 'any migration touching table X' — a new migration file name (0036_*.sql) does not name the table. Proposal: optional `diffMatch` regex on a part evaluated over the diff's added lines, with `paths` as the prefilter (e.g. paths server/migrations/**, diffMatch ALTER TABLE\s+agents\b).
`measure` always writes .test-scope/metrics.jsonl even when --config points to a config elsewhere; the metrics file should live next to the chosen config (or be settable).
